latest.title: Local classification of chsc Kähler metrics with cone singularities
latest.abstract: Let $B\subset\mathbb{C}^n$ be a ball centred at the origin and $D=\{z^1=0\}$. Let $g$ be a Kähler metric of constant holomorphic sectional curvature (chsc) on $B\setminus D$, uniformly equivalent to the model cone metric of angle $2πβ$, with $0<β<1$, and polyhomogeneous along $D$. We prove that, in suitable holomorphic coordinates $(w^1, \ldots, w^n)$ centred at the origin, the metric $g$ is the pullback of the corresponding complex space form by the map $(w^1,w^2,\dots,w^n)\longmapsto \bigl((w^1)^β,w^2,\dots,w^n\bigr)$.
latest.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
latest.workSummary: 局部分类沿光滑除子有锥奇点的常全纯截曲率 Kähler 度量，给出复空间形式的分支拉回模型。
latest.breakthrough: 确定所列正则性类中锥角与局部标准模型的关系。
latest.limitations: 锥角0<β<1、一致等价及多齐次正则性是前提，且只作局部分类。 已补读引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。 正文附录 A 另声称其余条件可推出多齐次性；需把局部分类与该正则性证明分开核查。
